newsitem.title: JAPAN: Greenspan says not concerned over Japan trade data.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan says not concerned over Japan trade data.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan told a news conference in Tokyo on Tuesday that he was not particularly concerned about Japan's latest trade figures.
Asked about Japan's latest trade figure and its affect on the Japanese currency, Greenspan said he did not have "any particular concern in that regard".

Japan's politically sensitive trade surplus with the United States surged in October, the first such rise in 20 months, as Japanese carmakers took advantage of the weak yen to export But Japan's overall surplus declined year-on-year for the 23rd consecutive month, to the surprise of the many economists who had expected it to rise.
